limitations.text: No warehouse inventory produced. The area has no labelled training examples (get_examples returned 0). The task has no imagery source (imagery_window returned not_allowed). zero_shot_text is not configured. The only embeddings are a synthetic 160 m fixture grid (idx-001, 3920 cells), which is not real AlphaEarth data. Without examples or imagery, I could not retrieve, classify or visually check any warehouse candidate. Picking a query location from prior knowledge of Chattogram would be unverifiable guesswork. Count: 0 confirmed, with an unknown true range. The whole AOI (about 10x9 km) is unreviewed. Absence of detections must not be read as absence of warehouses.

understanding.goal_restated: Find warehouses (>=~1600 m2 logistics/storage buildings) in the AOI near Chattogram, Bangladesh (91.78-91.88E, 22.28-22.36N), report points with a count range and explicit gaps.
known_limits: 10 m Sentinel-2/embeddings can barely resolve 40 m buildings; warehouses vs factories hard to distinguish
understanding.scope: AOI ~10x9 km, year 2024. Warehouse inventory only; no completeness claim.
